title: The abc index: Exact Retrieval for Learned Sparse Representations
abstract: arXiv:2611.28555v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In learned sparse retrieval (LSR), queries have tens of terms with learned weights, on which classic dynamic pruning is believed to fail, and approximate indexes such as Seismic and HNSW are considered faster than exact ones. We challenge this view with abc, an exact index built only from standard IR techniques: term-at-a-time (TAAT) evaluation, Block-Max MaxScore, binary packing and doc-id reordering. They are combined in a new design and engineered for modern CPUs. On MS MARCO encoded with four LSR models, the abc index is the fastest exact index at every k: 6.5-84x faster than the exact search of Qdrant, 13-55x faster than that of Lucene, and 2.9-18x faster than BMP with an index 5-7x smaller. Against approximate indexes, it takes 1.5-3.6x less space, and its latency grows much more slowly with k: they are up to 4.3x faster at k=10, but at k=1000 it overtakes them, by up to 7.4x. translated_title: abc索引：面向学习型稀疏表示的精确检索
translated_abstract: 在学习型稀疏检索（LSR）中，查询包含数十个带有学习权重的词项，人们普遍认为经典的动态剪枝技术在此会失效，而Seismic和HNSW等近似索引被认为比精确索引更快。我们用abc索引挑战这一观点——这是一种仅由标准信息检索技术构建的精确索引：逐词项（TAAT）评估、Block-Max MaxScore、二进制压缩编码和文档ID重排序。这些技术被以一种全新的设计组合起来，并针对现代CPU进行了工程优化。在用四种LSR模型编码的MS MARCO数据集上，abc索引在任何k值下都是最快的精确索引：比Qdrant的精确检索快6.5-84倍，比Lucene快13-55倍，比BMP快2.9-18倍且索引体积缩小5-7倍。与近似索引相比，它的空间占用少1.5-3.6倍，且其延迟随k值增长要缓慢得多：在k=10时近似索引最多可快4.3倍，但在k=1000时abc反超它们，最多快7.4倍。精确性还带来一个额外的好处：没有……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: abc索引仅用标准IR技术（TAAT评估、Block-Max MaxScore、二进制压缩和文档ID重排序）构建，在MS MARCO上成为各种k值下最快的精确LSR检索索引，不仅比现有精确索引快数倍到数十倍且体积更小，还能在大k值时反超近似索引并节省1.5-3.6倍空间。
en_tdlr: The abc index, built purely from standard IR techniques (TAAT, Block-Max MaxScore, binary packing, and doc-id reordering), is the fastest exact index for learned sparse retrieval at every k, outperforming exact competitors by up to 84x and even beating approximate indexes like Seismic and HNSW at large k while using 1.5-3.6x less space.
